description:
In-process integration: one Beadwork ticket from `/bw run` through implementation child settle without tmux, without closing the ticket automatically.

## Background

First vertical slice proving the two packages together. **This issue owns the reusable scripted-parent / temp git / Beadwork fixture harness** used by the ticket-policy and scope-policy epic e2es. Those siblings add scenario files; they must not fork a second harness.

## Approach

Temporary git+bw fixture. Scripted/stub parent turns. Real orchestrate + session factory. PATH without tmux. Child output may be **prose-only** (no schema).

Assert:

- no tmux process; no worktree created
- `/bw run` inject happened (captured payload: ids + policy + refresh, not a frozen ready list)
- print/json `/bw run` would reject (unit or this harness)
- orchestrate handle returns before completion; `accepted` is starting not liveness
- parent not blocked while child runs
- domain metadata on the child
- settlement does not close the issue
- exact active-tool set: inspection allowlist present; `beadwork_close_issue` / start / reopen absent; no parent `orchestrate`/`spawn`/`halt` on the child
- list_minions shows orchestrated child with description/taskType
- packet contents: changed child + fleet + delimited nudge (once packets exist)

## Success criteria

- Deterministic CI, no paid LLM.
- Harness is importable by 4.3 and 4.6.

## Test plan / logging

Every step logs: timestamp, step, epic id, ticket id, child id, group id, issue status, packet count.

On failure dump: injected prompt, last packet, fleet snapshot, `bw show` ticket, active tools. Not production telemetry.

## Considerations

Needs packets, spawn-compat allowlist, /bw run, worker tools gone, inspection/halt tools.

comments.text: Owns the reusable scripted-parent/git/bw harness for 4.3 and 4.6.
